text.p: The Palestinian Authority on Sunday ended a state of emergency in West Bank and Gaza hospitals that it had called on June 11 following a sharp rise in meningitis cases.
"We announce the end of the state of emergency," Palestinian Health Minister Ziad al-Zanoun told a news conference in Gaza.
Zanoun said 5,400 people had been treated for meningitis during the emergency with 85 percent of the cases in the Gaza Strip. No one died.
Meningitis usually affects children and can be transmitted through the respiratory and digestive systems.
